content: Our meetings take place every other Monday at 7:00 AM in the Galleria Food Court, located at 350 Longwood Avenue, Boston, Massachusetts. The first international meeting of WikiDoc will be held from January 18th to January 20th, 2006. Members of WikiDoc from across the globe are invited to participate in this inaugural annual meeting. The event will take place at 350 Longwood Avenue, Boston, Massachusetts, USA. One of the primary objectives of this meeting will be to discuss and plan the organization and expansion of WikiDoc in countries such as Poland, Russia, China, and Romania. Additionally, a Gala Dinner is scheduled to take place on January 18th at 5:30 PM at 350 Longwood Avenue.
